title: TraceQA collector output
description: What the in-page collector script returns from one call in one frame. The collector reports facts only. Grouping and fingerprinting happen in the engine.

height.description: Full scrollable height of the document.

RawElement.description: One interactive element exactly as found on the page.

role.description: ARIA role, explicit or implied by the tag. 'generic' when there is none.

name.description: Accessible name. Empty string when the element has none.

nameSource.description: Where the name came from. Known values: aria-label, aria-labelledby, label, content, alt, title, placeholder, value.

attrs.description: A fixed subset of attributes when present: id, data-testid, type, href, name, placeholder.

text.description: Visible text, trimmed and capped at 200 characters.

selectors.description: Ways to find this exact element again, most stable first. Each is a CSS selector inside the element's frame. For an element in shadow DOM the selector has parts joined by ' >>> ': each part is resolved inside the shadow root of the element the previous part matched.

path.description: Meaningful ancestors from the document root down to the parent. Only ancestors that have a non-generic role or that repeat among their siblings are listed.

name.description: Accessible name of the ancestor, when it has one.

repeatIndex.description: Zero-based position among siblings with the same tag and role. Present only when repeatCount is 2 or more.

repeatCount.description: How many siblings share this tag and role.

InteractiveEvidence.description: Why the collector thinks this element can be interacted with.

signals.description: Known values: native, role, tabindex, onclick-attr, cursor-pointer, contenteditable.
